senses.gloss: 1. उपम॑ mf(आ)n. uppermost, highest
most excellent, eminent, best, RV.; AV.
nearest, next, first, RV.; Nigh.
2. उपम mfn. ifc. for 3. उप-मा, q.v.
1. उपमा॑ (for 2. See below, and for 3. See col. 3) ind. (Ved. instr. of the above) in the closest proximity or neighbourhood, RV. i, 31, 15; viii, 69, 13.

2. उप-√ मा P. Ā. (Impv. 2. sg. -मिमीहि, -माहि, and -मास्व; Subj. 2. sg. -मासि) to measure out to, apportion to, assign, allot, grant, give, RV. : Ā. -मिमीते, to measure one thing by another, compare, MBh.; Hariv.; Caurap. &c.
3. उप-मा॑ f. comparison, resemblance, equality, similarity
a resemblance (as a picture, portrait &c.), ŚBr.; MBh.; Kum. &c.
a particular figure in rhetoric, simile, comparison (a full simile must include four things; see पूर्णोपम, लुप्तोपमा, &c.), Sāh.; Kāvyād.; Vām. &c.
a particle of comparison, Nir.
a particular metre, RPrāt.
उप-मा (mfn. ifc.) equal, similar, resembling, like (e.g. अमरोपम mfn. resembling an immortal), MBh.; Ragh.; Daś.; Hit. &c.
उपम॑—श्रवस् mfn. of highest fame, highly renowned
उपम॑—श्रवस् m. N. of a son of Kuru-śravaṇa and grandson of Mitrātithi, RV. x, 33, 6; 7
उपम—श्रवस्—तम mfn. highly renowned, illustrious, RV. ii, 23, 1.
उपमा॑म् ind. in the highest degree, RV. v, 34, 9; AV. viii, 3, 65; SV.
उप-√ मज्ज् P. Ā. -मज्जति, -ते, to dive, sink, ŚBr.; Lāṭy.; ŚāṅkhŚr. Comm. on KātyŚr.
उप-मज्जन n. ablution, bathing, a bath, BhP.

उप-√ मथ् P. -मन्थति, to whirl around, RV. x, 136, 7;
to stir, churn, mix, TBr. i, 6, 8, 4; 5.
उप-मथित mfn. stirred, churned, mixed, ŚBr. ii, 6, 1, 6; Kauś.
उप-मथ्य ind.p. having stirred
churning, mixing, Kauś.; ChUp.
उप-मन्थन n. stirring up, Kauś.
उप-मन्थनी॑ f. a staff for stirring, ŚBr.
उप-मन्थनी॑ See above.
उप-मन्थितृ॑ mfn. one who stirs or churns (butter &c.), VS. xxx, 12.
उप-√ 1. मद् P. -मदति, to cheer up, encourage, ŚBr. i, 4, 2, 1.
उप-मा॑द m. enjoyment, amusement, RV. iii, 5, 5.
उप-माद See उप-√ मद्.
उप-मद्गु m. N. of a younger brother of Madgu, Hariv.; VP.
उप-मध्यमा f. (scil. अङ्गुलि) the finger next to the middle finger, the last finger but one, ĀpŚr. iii, 1, 2.
उपा-√ मन्त्र्
उप-मन्त्रण n. the art of persuading coaxing (= रहस्य् उप-च्छन्दनम्, Kāś.), Pāṇ. i, 3, 47.
उ॑प-मन्त्रित mfn. called near or hither, ŚBr.; ChUp. &c.
summoned, invited, persuaded, MBh.; Hariv.
addressed, Daś.
उपा-मन्त्रित mfn. addressed, called upon, summoned, BhP.
1. उप-मन्त्रि॑न् mfn. persuading, inciting, impelling, RV. ix, 112, 4.
2. उप-मन्त्रिन् m. a subordinate counsellor, BhP.
उप-मन्यु॑ mfn. striving after, zealous [BRD.], RV. i, 102, 9
(knowing, understanding, intelligent, Sāy.)
उप-मन्यु॑ (उस्), m. N. of a Ṛṣi (pupil of Āyoda-dhaumya, who aided Śiva in the propagation of his doctrine and received the ocean of milk from him), MBh.; LiṅgaP.; Kathās. &c.
उप-मन्यु॑ (अवस्), m. pl. the descendants of the above, ĀśvŚr. (cf. औपमन्यव.)
उप-मर्द &c. See उप-√ मृद्.
उप-मर्द m. friction, rubbing down
pressure, Sāh.; Kathās.
injury, violation
destruction, MBh. Comm. on BṛĀrUp. & Nyāyad.
suppression (of a sound), Nyāyad. ii, 2, 59.
उप-मा—द्रव्य n. any object used for comparison, Kum.
उप-मा—रूपक n. (in rhet.) a particular figure combining comparison and metaphor, Vām.
उप-मा—व्यतिरेक m. (in rhet.) a particular figure combining comparison and contrast, Kāvyād.
उपमेत m. the tree Vatica Robusta, L.
(वृक्षाणां मध्ये तस्य सर्वोच्चत्वाद् अन्यस्योपोमानतां प्राप्तत्वात् तथात्वम्, T.)
1. उ॑प-माति f. (for 2. See s.v.), इस् comparison, similarity [Sāy.], RV.
उ॑प-माति m. (इस्) ‘assigning or granting’ (wealth), N. of Agni [Sāy.], RV. viii, 60, 11
(BRD. derives both 1. and 2. उप-माति fr. उप-√ मन्, ‘to address’.)
2. उप-माति f. (√ 1. मी, Sāy.), destroying, killing.
1. उप-मातृ mfn. (for 2. See s.v.) one who compares, Naiṣ.
an image-maker, portrait-painter, L.
2. उप-मातृ f. ‘second mother’, foster-mother, nurse, L.
a near female relative, L.
उप-मान n. comparison, resemblance, analogy, MBh.; Suśr.; Kathās. &c.
simile
the object with which anything is compared, Pāṇ.; Sāh.; Kum. &c.
a particle of comparison, Nir.
(in log.) recognition of likeness, comparison (the third of the four Pramāṇas or means of correct knowledge)
उप-मान mfn. (ifc.) similar, like, Kathās.
उप-मान—चिन्ता-मणि m. N. of a philosophical work.
उप-मान—ता f.
उप-मान—त्व n. similarity, Kathās.
the state of being an object of comparison, Sāh.; Vām.
उप-मान—वत् mfn. similar, like, Śatr.
उपमानोपमेय-भाव m. the connection between the thing to be compared and the object with which it is compared.
1. उप-मित mfn. (for 2. See उप-√ मि) compared, illustrated by comparison, Pāṇ.; Bhartṛ. &c.
similar.
2. उप-मित (for 1. See above) mfn. stuck or fastened on, put into, Vait.
उप-मिति f. comparison
resemblance, likeness, similarity, Sāh.
analogy
knowledge of things derived from analogy or resemblance, Sarvad.
उप-मेय mfn. to be compared, comparable with (with instr. or ifc.), Megh.; Kum. &c.
उप-मेय n. that which is compared, the subject of comparison (opposed to उप-मान, the object with which anything is compared), Sāh. Comm. on Pāṇ.
उपमेयोपमा f. the resemblance of any object to that compared with it
reciprocal comparison (as of a moon to a beautiful face), Vām.; Kpr.
उप-मा॑त् f. a prop, support = उपमि॑त् below [Sāy.], RV. vi, 67, 6.
उप-माति—व॑नि mfn. engaged in killing enemies, destroyer of enemies [Sāy.], RV. v, 41, 16
(fr. उप-√ मन्, one who receives addresses in a friendly way, BRD.)
उप-मारण See उप-√ मृ.
उप-मारण n. the act of throwing into water, submerging, KātyŚr. xx, 8, 22.
उप-मालिनी f. a particular metre.
उप-मालिनी-तीरम् ind. near the banks of the Mālinī, Śak. 16, 7.
उ॑पमास्य mfn. (fr. उप-मासम्), occurring every month, monthly, AV. viii, 10, 19.
उप-√ 1. मि P. -मिनोति, to stick or fasten on, put into, Kāṭh.
उप-मि॑त् त्, f. a prop, stay, RV. i, 59, 1; iv, 5, 1; AV. ix, 3, 1.
उप-मित्र n. a minor friend, not an intimate friend, Nīlak.
उप-√ मिह् Caus. -मेहयति, to wet, BhP. vi, 16, 32.
उप-मीमांसा (fr. Desid. of √ मन्), deliberation, investigation, consideration, ŚBr. xi, 4, 2, 12; 15.
उप-मुखम् ind. on the mouth, Lāṭy. iv, 2, 6.
उप-√ मुच् Ā. -मुञ्चते, to put on (e.g. shoes), TS.; TBr.; KātyŚr.; Kauś.
उप-मूल॑म् ind. on or at the root, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Kauś.; Gobh.

उप-√ मृ Caus. -मारयति, to throw into water, plunge, immerse, ŚBr. Comm. on KātyŚr.;
 (with अप्सु), ĀpŚr. viii, 8, 12.
उप-√ मॄ Pass. (p. -मूर्य॑माण) to be worn away or destroyed, ŚBr. i, 7, 3, 21; 4, 12.
(Pass. -मूर्यते), to be destroyed, ŚBr.
उ॑प-मृत mfn. died, dead, TS. vi, 2, 8, 6.

उप-√ मृज् P. -मार्ष्टि (3. pl. -मृजन्ति, RV. ix, 15, 7) to stroke;
to touch, sweep, wipe, cleanse, TBr.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
उप-मर्दक mfn. destroying, annulling, oppressing, Hariv.; Kathās.; Sarvad.
उप-मर्दन n. the act of injuring, violation
suppression, oppression Comm. on KātyŚr.
उप-मर्दिन् mfn. ifc. destroying, annulling, BhP.
उप-√ मृष् Caus.
उप-मर्षित mfn. borne patiently, tolerated
granted, not begrudged, MBh.
उप-मेखलम् ind. about or on the slopes or sides (of a mountain), Kir. vii, 32.
उप-√ म्लुच् P. (pf. -मुम्लोच) to hide one's self among (with gen.), ŚBr. i, 2, 5, 8.
उप-√ म्लुप्
उ॑प-म्लुप्त mfn. hidden, concealed, TBr. iii, 2, 9, 4.
उपा-मन्त्र्य ind.p. having addressed, addressing, summoning, R.; BhP.
taking leave, bidding adieu, MBh.; Hariv.
